cases.name: Acererak the Archlich
cases.text:
When Acererak enters, if you haven't completed Tomb of Annihilation, return Acererak to its owner's hand and venture into the dungeon.
Whenever Acererak attacks, for each opponent, you create a 3/2 black Zombie creature token unless that player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
